title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jalen McMillan (knee) practices in full Wednesday
items.desc: Jalen McMillan (knee) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
items.impact: McMillan was technically active in Week 2 but only saw seven snaps on offense. He is starting out the week as a full participant this week and seems likely to be full health for Sunday's game against the Vikings, so we could see the team ramp him back up to a full workload as soon as this weekend.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Baker Mayfield (illness) practices in full Wednesday
items.desc: Baker Mayfield (illness) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran quarterback was able to practice in a full capacity on Wednesday, despite being listed on the injury report due to an illness. It shouldn't affect his availability for Sunday's game against the Vikings, but he still doesn't project to be a good fantasy option for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brenen Thompson (quad) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Brenen Thompson (quad) did not practice for the Chargers on Wednesday.
items.impact: Thompson wasn't able to practice due to a quad issue on Wednesday. He seemed to play a real role in Los Angeles' offense last week, so if he has to miss time, Quentin Johnston and Tre' Harris may see more work as a result of his absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kayode Awosika (leg) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Kayode Awosika (leg) missed Los Angeles' practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Awosika was not able to practice due to a leg injury on Wednesday. Los Angeles currently has several starting linemen who are dealing with an injury right now, so their front five may be weaker than usual in a tough matchup against the Bills this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cole Strange (pec) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Cole Strange (pec) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Los Angeles has multiple starting linemen on their injury report right now, including Strange, who was limited at practice due to a pec injury. He looks likely to play in Week 3, although we won't know for sure until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rashawn Slater (groin) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Rashawn Slater (groin) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Slater is a new addition to Los Angeles' injury report, being listed with a groin issue that left him limited at practice on Wednesday. It doesn't seem serious enough to prevent him from playing in Week 3, however, which is good news for Los Angeles' entire offense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ladd McConkey (rib) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Ladd McConkey (rib) logged a full practice session to start the week on Wednesday.
items.impact: McConkey was able to play through his rib injury last week and is now a full participant to start this week, meaning that he is close to full health and should be fully good to go for Week 3. He had an underwhelming performance last week but has a chance to bounce back this week in what should be a competitive matchup against the Bills on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jauan Jennings (personal) good to go for Week 3
items.desc: Jauan Jennings (personal) will be good to go for Week 3's matchup against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
items.impact: Jennings missed last week's game due to a personal issue that he was tending to, but he is back and fully good to go ahead of Minnesota's matchup against the Buccaneers in Week 3. He should play but isn't expected to be a relevant fantasy option for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Blake Cashman (wrist) without injury designation for Week 3
items.desc: Blake Cashman (wrist) is without an injury designation for Week 3's matchup against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
items.impact: Cashman is going to be good to go in Week 3, as he is no longer listed on Minnesota's injury report heading into the week. He should continue to play a big role for them for as long as he can remain healthy and on the field.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brian O'Neill (knee) a limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Brian O'Neill (knee) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: O'Neill was limited by a knee injury on Wednesday. He was able to play through that issue last week, however, so it doesn't seem to pose much of a threat to his availability for Week 3. Minnesota's offensive line is much stronger when he is available to suit up and play for them.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Andrew Van Ginkel (chest) good to go for Week 3
items.desc: Andrew Van Ginkel (chest) will be good to go for Week 3's matchup against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
items.impact: The veteran defender should be good to go for Week 3, as he is now off of the injury report after dealing with a chest issue for a little while. His presence is important for a Minnesota defense that has looked very strong through the first two weeks of the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DeeJay Dallas (toe) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: DeeJay Dallas (toe) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Dallas was not able to practice in full on Wednesday due to a toe injury that he's dealing with. Aaron Jones (knee) is at risk of being sidelined in Week 3, in which case the 28-year old would be primed for more work than usual against the Buccaneers, assuming he himself is healthy.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) officially a non-participant Wednesday
items.desc: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) was officially a non-participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: We knew that Jones was going to miss Wednesday's practice early in the day, but now the official injury report tells us that it's a knee injury that he's dealing with. It seems like it could threaten his availability for Week 3, so fantasy managers should keep close tabs on updates about his health throughout the rest of the week to see if he'll be sidelined or not.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Marvin Mims Jr. (foot) considered limited Wednesday
items.desc: Marvin Mims Jr. (foot) was considered limited at Denver's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Mims wasn't able to play last week due to a foot injury of some kind, but he was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday and seems to have a good chance to play in Week 3. His return would only have real implications for Denver's special teams unit on Sunday night, so he shouldn't be considered a worthwhile fantasy asset for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jonah Coleman (ankle) officially a non-participant Wednesday
items.desc: Jonah Coleman (ankle) was officially a non-participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Initial reports indicates that the rookie may have been practicing for the Broncos on Wednesday, but it turns out that he was a non-participant because of the ankle issue that he's dealing with. He is currently trending the wrong way for Week 3, and his absence would likely lead to more work for RJ Harvey (hamstring) against the Rams.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: RJ Harvey (hamstring) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: RJ Harvey (hamstring) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Harvey was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday after missing last week's game due to a hamstring injury. It looks like he's trending towards playing in Week 3 and could see more work than usual if Jonah Coleman (ankle) is ruled out ahead of the team's matchup against the Rams on Sunday night.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: J.K. Dobbins (hip) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: J.K. Dobbins (hip) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Dobbins was a officially a limited participant for the Broncos on Wednesday due to a hip injury that he recently suffered. It looks like he will have a good chance to play through it in Week 3, and he will be primed for more work than usual if one or both of RJ Harvey (hamstring) and Jonah Coleman (ankle) are sidelined against the Rams on Sunday night.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dareke Young (hamstring) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Dareke Young (hamstring) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Young is now listed on Las Vegas' injury report due to a hamstring issue of some kind and was limited at practice on Wednesday as a result. It could leave him sidelined for Week 3, but even if that's the case, fantasy managers shouldn't expect much change in Las Vegas' offense as a result.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brock Bowers (knee) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Brock Bowers (knee) was officially limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Bowers has been sidelined for the first two weeks of the season after undergoing a minor operation on his knee, but it looks like he is nearing a return for the Raiders. He was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday, and it seems like the expectation of the team is that he will play this week. Fantasy managers shouldn't hesitate to start him if he's cleared to play in Sunday's game without any major restrictions to his workload.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kamren Kinchens not expected to practice Wednesday
items.desc: Kamren Kinchens is not expected to take part in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Kinchens is not expected to practice on Wednesday, though it's not exactly clear what issue he is dealing with right now. We should learn more when the team's official injury report releases later in the day.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Colby Parkinson unlikely to practice Wednesday
items.desc: Colby Parkinson is unlikely to take part in Los Angeles' practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: HC Sean McVay told reporters that Parkinson is unlikely to take part in Wednesday's walkthrough, though we don't have an official injury designation for him as of now. We should know more about his status over the course of the next few hours.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jordan Whittington (quad) likely a non-participant Wednesday
items.desc: Jordan Whittington (quad) is likely to be a non-participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Whittington is not expected to take part in Los Angeles' walkthrough on Wednesday, though the team's official injury report has yet to release. He could miss another game, which would open up more opportunities for Terrance Ferguson again, especially if Puka Nacua (hip) is also sidelined for another game.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Puka Nacua (hip) not expected to practice Wednesday
items.desc: Puka Nacua (hip) is not expected to practice on Wednesday and is uncertain to play in Week 3.
items.impact: HC Sean McVay told reporters that Nacua is not expected to take part in practice on Wednesday and that the team is still unsure about his availability for Week 3. He also remarked that he is not concerned about it being a long-term injury for the star wideout. Fantasy managers should keep close tabs on Nacua's status throughout the week, as 	Davante Adams will again be a must-start fantasy option if the 25-year old is sidelined for another game.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ed Ingram (groin) a non-participant Wednesday
items.desc: Ed Ingram (groin) was a non-participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Houston's starting guard is dealing with a groin injury right now and wasn't able to take part in Wednesday's practice. We should know more about his official status for Week 3 sometime after practice on Thursday or Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dalton Schultz (rest) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Dalton Schultz (rest) missed Houston's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The Texans gave Schultz Wednesday's practice off as a veteran rest day for him after he caught 12 passes in Week 2. He should be back in the lineup very soon and will be primed for more work than usual again this week if Nico Collins (hamstring) is sidelined for another game.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Nico Collins (hamstring) officially doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Nico Collins (hamstring) was officially a non-participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The star wideout was not able to practice for the Texans on Wednesday. He is still recovering from a hamstring injury that left him sidelined last week, and it's very possible that is will force him to miss another game this week. Look for Dalton Schultz and Xavier Hutchinson to continue to see more work than usual if that's the case.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Andrew Thomas (ankle) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Andrew Thomas (ankle) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
items.impact: New York's star offensive lineman was able to log a full practice session on Wednesday, despite recently dealing with an ankle injury of some kind. His presence will be important for backup QB Jameis Winston if New York's offense wants to keep any momentum with Jaxson Dart (knee) out for an extended period of time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Malik Nabers (shoulder) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: Malik Nabers (shoulder) was officially limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Nabers is nursing a shoulder injury that he suffered in Week 2 and was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday as a result. It looks likely that he will play through it in Week 3, but fantasy managers should still continue to monitor updates about his health throughout the rest of the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chase Young (calf) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Chase Young (calf) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Young is still on New Orleans' injury report due to a calf issue, but he was able to play through it in Week 2 and looks likely to do the same again in Week 3. His presence would be nice for the Saints ahead of a favorable matchup against the Raiders this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Etienne is a new addition to New Orleans' injury report, being listed with a hamstring injury that left him limited at practice on Wednesday. It remains unclear whether or not it will affect his availability for Week 3, and this is a situation fantasy managers should continue to monitor throughout the week, especially with Etienne losing so much work to Alvin Kamara in his return game last week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Maximus Pulley signs with Rams
items.desc: The Rams signed S Maximus Pulley.
items.impact: Pulley will add depth in the secondary for the Rams.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ronnie Rivers placed on IR
items.desc: The Rams placed RB Ronnie Rivers on injured reserve.
items.impact: Rivers will miss at least the next four games for the Rams.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Devontez Walker (groin) off injury report for Week 3
items.desc: Devontez Walker (groin) is off of the injury report ahead of Week 3's matchup against the Dallas Cowboys.
items.impact: It looks like Walker will be a full go for Week 3, as he is no longer listed with the groin injury that gave him some problems earlier on in the season. He should play and will see more work than usual if Zay Flowers (hamstring) has to miss another game for Baltimore.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Preston Smith works out for Colts
items.desc: The Colts hosted DE Preston Smith for a workout.
items.impact: Smith appeared in 13 games for the Commanders last season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: David Ojabo works out for Colts
items.desc: The Colts hosted DE David Ojabo for a workout.
items.impact: Ojabo was one of three defensive ends to work out for the Colts. He has appeared in 27 games the past two seasons for the Ravens.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Moore (ankle) a limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Chris Moore (ankle) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The Ravens listed Moore as a limited participant on Wednesday due to an ankle injury that he's dealing with. If it leaves him sidelined this week, look for Devontez Walker to see more work as a result of his absence.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Carl Lawson works out for Colts
items.desc: The Colts hosted DE Carl Lawson for a workout.
items.impact: Lawson appeared in one game with the Ravens last season. He was one of three defensive ends to without for the Colts.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Teddye Buchanan (knee) practices in full Wednesday
items.desc: Teddye Buchanan (knee) was a full participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Buchanan continues to draw closer and closer to a return to the lineup. He was able to log a full practice session on Wednesday, which puts him right in line to be back and available to play in Week 3. We'll know more about his official status later on in the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Simmons (back) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Josh Simmons did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Simmons remains without a clear timetable to return.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ronnie Stanley (toe) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Ronnie Stanley (toe) missed Baltimore's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran lineman was held out of practice on Wednesday as part of the injury management for his toe issue. It looks likely that he will play through it in Week 3, assuming he suffers no setbacks with his recovery between now and then.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: L'Jarius Sneed (knee) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: L'Jarius Sneed was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Sneed opens the week on the injury report with a knee issue. He has played a big role in the Chiefs secondary to begin the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: John Simpson (groin) limited Wednesday
items.desc: John Simpson (groin) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Simpson was limited at Wednesday's practice due to the same groin injury that has been bothering him for a while. He was able to play through it last week, however, and projects to do the same again this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mansoor Delane (shoulder) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Mansoor Delane was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Delane remains on track to return to a full-go on Sunday against the Dolphins after leaving Week 1 early.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Nnamdi Madubuike (neck) practices in full Thursday
items.desc: Nnamdi Madubuike (neck) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: Madubuike seems to be trending the right way for Week 3 after logging a full practice to start the week on Wednesday. His potential return would be timely for the Ravens ahead of a tough road matchup against the Cowboys this weekend.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rashee Rice (knee) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Rashee Rice was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Rice remains on the injury report with a knee issue, but it shouldn't impact his status heading into Week 3. He remains a borderline WR1/WR2 play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Trey Hendrickson (finger) sidelined at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Trey Hendrickson (finger) was sidelined at Baltimore's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Hendrickson was able to play through his finger injury in Week 2, so it isn't too concerning that he was a non-participant at practice on Wednesday. He should be active for Week 3 as well, assuming he suffers no setbacks between now and then.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Bell (knee) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Chris Bell was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Bell opens the week on the injury report with a knee issue. He remains in a limited role right now in the Dolphins offense.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chop Robinson (concussion) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Chop Robinson was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Robinson remains in concussion protocol. He is continuing to progress in the right direction.
